name: Formicariidae
description: Antthrushes are medium-sized, ground-dwelling passerines of Neotropical forests. They resemble thrushes in shape and behavior but are unrelated, deriving their name from their ant-following habits.

children.name: Chamaeza
children.description: Chamaeza is the primary genus of antthrushes in the family Formicariidae, found in South American forests.

children.name: Chamaeza campanisona
children.description: The short-tailed antthrush (Chamaeza campanisona) is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae. It is found in every mainland South American country except Chile, French Guiana, and Uruguay.

children.name: Chamaeza ruficauda
children.description: The rufous-tailed antthrush or Brazilian antthrush (Chamaeza ruficauda) is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae. It is found in Argentina and Brazil.

children.name: Chamaeza nobilis
children.description: The striated antthrush (Chamaeza nobilis), sometimes called the noble antthrush , is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae.

children.name: Chamaeza turdina
children.description: Schwartz's antthrush (Chamaeza turdina), also known as the scalloped antthrush, is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae. It is found in Colombia and Venezuela.

children.name: Chamaeza meruloides
children.description: The cryptic antthrush (Chamaeza meruloides), also known as Such's antthrush, is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae.

children.name: Chamaeza olivacea
children.description: An antthrush from the eastern Andes.

children.name: Chamaeza stolzmanni
children.description: An antthrush from the Andes of Peru and Bolivia.

children.name: Chamaeza mollissima
children.description: The barred antthrush (Chamaeza mollissima) is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae.

children.name: Formicarius
children.description: Formicarius — a genus of antthrushes in the family Formicariidae.

children.name: Formicarius analis
children.description: The black-faced antthrush (Formicarius analis) is a species of passerine bird in the family Formicariidae. It is found in Central America from Honduras through Panama, on Trinidad, and in every mainland South American country except Argentina, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay.

children.name: Formicarius colma
children.description: The rufous-capped antthrush (Formicarius colma) is a small species of bird in the family Formicariidae located in the order Passeriformes. It is considered to be uncommon but widespread, found in Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, French Guiana, Guyana, Peru, Suriname, and Venezuela. The rufous-capped antthrush is typically found inhabiting the shady floor of tall, humid forests on solid ground, and is occasionally spotted in transitional forests and savanna forests (Suriname).

children.name: Formicarius nigricapillus
children.description: The black-headed antthrush (Formicarius nigricapillus) is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae. It is found in Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, and Panama.

children.name: Formicarius rufifrons
children.description: The rufous-fronted antthrush (Formicarius rufifrons) is a species of bird in the family Formicariidae. It is found in Bolivia, Brazil, and Peru.

children.name: Hylopezus berlepschi
children.description: The Amazonian antpitta (Myrmothera berlepschi) is a species of bird in the family Grallariidae.

children.name: Hylopezus dives
children.description: The thicket antpitta (Myrmothera dives) is a species of bird in the family Grallariidae.

children.name: Cercomacra serva
children.description: The black antbird (Cercomacroides serva) is a species of passerine bird in subfamily Thamnophilinae of family Thamnophilidae, the "typical antbirds".
